sn22.59:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati isipatane migadāye.
sn22.59:1.2: tatra kho bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū āmantesi
sn22.59:2.2: rūpañca hidaṃ bhikkhave attā abhavissa na yidaṃ rūpaṃ ābādhāya saṃvatteyya labbhetha ca rūpe
sn22.59:2.3: evaṃ me rūpaṃ hotu evaṃ me rūpaṃ mā ahosīti.
sn22.59:2.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave rūpaṃ anattā tasmā rūpaṃ ābādhāya saṃvattati na ca labbhati rūpe
sn22.59:2.5: evaṃ me rūpaṃ hotu evaṃ me rūpaṃ mā ahosīti.
sn22.59:3.2: vedanā ca hidaṃ bhikkhave attā abhavissa na yidaṃ vedanā ābādhāya saṃvatteyya labbhetha ca vedanāya
sn22.59:3.3: evaṃ me vedanā hotu evaṃ me vedanā mā ahosīti.
sn22.59:3.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave vedanā anattā tasmā vedanā ābādhāya saṃvattati na ca labbhati vedanāya
sn22.59:3.5: evaṃ me vedanā hotu evaṃ me vedanā mā ahosīti.
sn22.59:4.3: saṅkhārā ca hidaṃ bhikkhave attā abhavissaṃsu na yidaṃ saṅkhārā ābādhāya saṃvatteyyuṃ labbhetha ca saṅkhāresu
sn22.59:4.4: evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu evaṃ me saṅkhārā mā ahesunti.
sn22.59:4.5: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave saṅkhārā anattā tasmā saṅkhārā ābādhāya saṃvattanti na ca labbhati saṅkhāresu
sn22.59:4.6: evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu evaṃ me saṅkhārā mā ahesunti.
sn22.59:5.2: viññāṇañca hidaṃ bhikkhave attā abhavissa na yidaṃ viññāṇaṃ ābādhāya saṃvatteyya labbhetha ca viññāṇe
sn22.59:5.3: evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ hotu evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ mā ahosīti.
sn22.59:5.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ anattā tasmā viññāṇaṃ ābādhāya saṃvattati na ca labbhati viññāṇe
sn22.59:5.5: evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ hotu evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ mā ahosīti.
sn22.59:6.4: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn22.59:6.6: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn22.59:6.7: etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti.
sn22.59:6.14: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn22.59:6.16: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn22.59:6.17: etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti.
sn22.59:7.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave yaṅkiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ rūpaṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn22.59:8.1: yā kāci vedanā atītānāgatapaccuppannā …pe… yā dūre santike vā sabbā vedanā netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn22.59:9.2: ye keci saṅkhārā atītānāgatapaccuppannā …pe… ye dūre santike vā sabbe saṅkhārā netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn22.59:10.1: yaṅkiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn22.59:11.1: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmiṃpi nibbindati vedanāyapi nibbindati saññāyapi nibbindati saṅkhāresupi nibbindati viññāṇasmiṃpi nibbindati
sn22.59:11.2: nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn22.59:11.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
sn22.59:12.2: attamanā pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanduṃ.
sn22.59:12.3: imasmiñca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne pañcavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsūti.
